tasks.short: Interview candidates, decide whom to hire and prepare and send the offer.

steps.what: Retrieve candidate applications, job requirements and hiring terms
Interview workers and clarify their relevant experience and suitability
Write interview observations and evidence against the job requirements
Evaluate candidates and decide whom to hire and on which terms
Write the offer using the selected worker and hiring terms
Check and send the final employment offer to the selected worker
Record the worker's response and final hiring status

tasks.design: Configure candidate views and interview fields in {ATS}, with an offer template in {DOCS}. Interviewing and hiring stay human; interview writing, offer preparation, the final {EMAIL} send and later status record are distinct.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated candidate navigation and offer and interview record formatting consume hiring time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native applicant fields and templates can reduce clerical handling.
tasks.still_hard: Fair assessment, suitability and defensible employment decisions.
tasks.human_edge: The manager evaluates evidence and stands behind the hiring choice.
tasks.altitude: Reduce hiring administration while preserving direct assessment.

reach.learn: Keep observed evidence separate from the selection decision

evidence.claim: The digest flags employment decisions as consequential uses requiring human intervention; this design keeps selection human.
Native applicant views and offer templates may reduce repeated handling; the saving is unmeasured.

assumptions: Includes interviewing, the separate evidence write, selection, offer writing, sending and response status.

Manager produces job-linked observations in s3 and selected candidate, terms and start details in s4-s5, then captures response in s7; all capture is counted. Missing or disputed terms require manual resolution.
Native ATS fields and offer templates first; no model scoring or ranking candidates.
Ordinary record and offer saves remain retained without self-approval; actual offer send has a final-version gate.
unknowns: Existing ATS fields and offer templates
research_questions: How much offer and interview writing is repeated structure rather than individual evidence?

already_counted.description: Capture interview evidence and hiring status

incremental.description: Maintain applicant fields and offer template

approvals.approved_version: Exact candidate, role, terms, start date and offer recipient; changed terms or recipient require another check before sending.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=89.5, gross=10.5, upkeep=2, central net=8.5 E1. Low: bespoke hiring terms and unstructured candidate records defeat most template reuse, retaining 98 hours plus upkeep for zero net. High: consistent candidate metadata and standard terms permit partial reuse while selection and interview content stay manual, retaining 93 hours plus upkeep for 5 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate player benefits and direct checked complimentary-item distribution.

steps.what: Retrieve player identity, length of play, betting totals and current benefit policy
Capture verified play totals, applicable policy bands and relevant restrictions
Calculate policy-based complimentary allowances from the verified play totals
Determine permissible complimentary items and resolve player-specific exceptions
Write the player benefit allocation and distribution instructions
Check and communicate final distribution instructions to the service colleague
Check and explain the final complimentary allocation to the player

tasks.design: Configure player views in {CRM} and existing policy calculations and allocation fields in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The manager verifies the inputs and decides permissible items; the written allocation, internal {CHAT} instruction and player explanation remain separate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual policy arithmetic and repeated allocation fields surround distribution decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit policy bands can be calculated deterministically from verified play records.
tasks.still_hard: Restrictions, exceptions, availability and appropriate treatment of the player.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can reject an arithmetically eligible allocation when circumstances require judgement.
tasks.altitude: Reduce calculation and record work while preserving accountable benefit decisions.

reach.learn: Separate policy calculation from discretionary allocation

evidence.claim: Native policy-band calculations and allocation fields can reduce manual arithmetic and repeated entry; no measured gambling-management result is supplied.

assumptions: Includes benefit verification, calculation, allocation decision, writing and both actual communications; service colleagues' delivery labour is not counted as saved.

Existing gaming records supply player ID, play duration and betting totals from their current transaction capture. Manager verifies and captures applicable totals, policy version, bands and restrictions in s2 at full effort; absent or disputed fields require manual investigation.
Native player views and policy settings first; if calculations already exist, remove their baseline and saving. No model profiles players or changes eligibility.
Ordinary allocation saves remain retained and ungated; actual instructions and player terms each have their own final-version check.
unknowns: Existing native benefit calculations and applicable restrictions
research_questions: Which allowance calculations are manual and which are already configured?

already_counted.description: Verify and capture calculation inputs and restrictions

incremental.description: Maintain policy calculations and test changed bands

approvals.approved_version: Exact player, items, value, conditions and service colleague receiving the instruction; changed terms require another check.
Exact final allocation and conditions for the verified player; changed allocation requires checking before explanation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=74, gross=26, upkeep=4, central net=22 E1. Low: inconsistent play-session metadata and exception-heavy restrictions require manual arithmetic and notes, retaining 94 hours plus upkeep for 2 net. High: compatible duration and betting fields permit band calculations while availability and exceptions stay manual, retaining 82 hours plus upkeep for 14 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Establish gambling and service policies and write and circulate the resulting policy version.

steps.what: Retrieve current policies, operating evidence and applicable requirements
Consult relevant colleagues about policy constraints and operating consequences
Determine policies on gambling, odds, credit or food and beverage service
Write the policy text, scope, exceptions and operational responsibilities

loop.purpose: Draft policy wording from explicit managerial decisions
loop.input: Decisions, scope, requirements references, exceptions and responsibilities
loop.output: Policy draft linking provisions to the supplied decisions or requirements
loop.check: Manager checks that wording preserves decisions, conditions and operational meaning
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported provision or ambiguous obligation returns to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates supply structure but cannot express each distinct policy change

steps.what: Revise policy clarity, consistency and fit with the established decisions
Check and circulate the final policy version to responsible colleagues

tasks.design: Use a native policy library and template in {DOCS}, then bounded wording assistance from the manager's explicit decisions. Consultation, policy choice, document revision and circulation through {EMAIL} remain separate human steps.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated policy navigation and prose construction surround consequential managerial choices.
tasks.enabler_now: A versioned library and constrained draft can reuse supplied decisions and references.
tasks.still_hard: Permissible commercial choices, operational consequences and unambiguous obligations.
tasks.human_edge: The manager understands and owns the policy's effects.
tasks.altitude: Reduce policy drafting while preserving managerial and regulatory judgement.

reach.learn: Keep each provision tied to a decision or requirement

evidence.claim: Clausematch supports versioned policy libraries and mappings to requirements, illustrating structured policy management.
The proposed policy drafting-time benefit is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Includes the policy document and its internal circulation rather than treating establishing policy as only a meeting.

Manager produces policy choice, scope, exception, owner and evidence references in s3-s4, with capture counted. Missing authority or unresolved requirement is handled manually before wording is finalised.
Native library and template first; the model cannot set odds, extend credit or choose policy.
No invented approval stage: s5 is author revision, and its ordinary save is retained without self-gating. s6 gates the actual circulated version.
unknowns: Existing policy library and scope of managerial authority
research_questions: Does draft assistance reduce total wording and correction effort on real policy revisions?

already_counted.description: Review and correct draft policy wording

incremental.description: Maintain policy drafting constraints and inspect output grounding

approvals.approved_version: Exact final policy, effective scope, exceptions and responsible recipients; any changed version requires another check before circulation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=85, gross=15, upkeep=4, central net=11 E1. Low: novel credit conditions and incompatible policy structure require extensive rewriting, retaining 95 hours plus upkeep for 1 net. High: comparable policy structure and clear decision metadata support some wording reuse while managerial choices and revision stay full, retaining 89 hours plus upkeep for 7 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe gaming tables, assess proper conduct and separately record and communicate concerns.

steps.what: Circulate among gaming tables and observe the operating context
Observe dealers, players and game procedures for house-rule compliance or cheating indicators
Determine whether observed conduct requires clarification or escalation
outputs: considered conduct concern or no-action finding

steps.what: Write the floor concern note and supporting observed facts
inputs: considered conduct concern or no-action finding

steps.what: Check and communicate the final concern to the responsible colleague

tasks.design: Keep circulation, observation and conduct assessment human, using a native concern-note form in {OPS_SYSTEM} for actual written findings. The concern write and any internal notification are separate from floor observation; no surveillance model or hidden alert is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: The physical judgement is not reducible, but repeated concern-note fields can add clerical work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native concern fields can reuse table, shift and case context.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising suspicious conduct without treating an indicator as proof.
tasks.human_edge: The manager reads live context and can investigate ambiguity.
tasks.altitude: Reduce actual concern-note handling while preserving direct floor oversight.

reach.learn: Record observed facts separately from suspicions

evidence.claim: Native incident record fields can reduce repeated concern-note formatting; this benefit is unmeasured and does not automate cheating detection.

assumptions: Baseline averages actual concern notes and notifications across floor oversight; no record is invented for every table visit.
Manager produces table, time, observed action and uncertainty in s4, with capture priced; no structured suspicion label is assumed to exist for free. Unclear facts stay explicitly unresolved.
Native incident form first; till settings and table dashboards do not replace the live judgement. No automatic accusation, staff scoring or machine send.
Ordinary concern-note saves stay retained without self-approval; the final internal notification is separately checked.
unknowns: Frequency and current format of actual concern notes
research_questions: How much concern-note effort repeats table and shift fields rather than describing observed facts?

already_counted.description: Capture observed facts and uncertainty in the concern record

approvals.approved_version: Exact concern, factual qualifications and responsible colleague; changed facts or recipient require another check before communication.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=96.25, gross=3.75, upkeep=1, central net=2.75 E1. Low: uncommon conduct and sparse table metadata require bespoke notes, retaining 99 hours plus upkeep for zero net. High: reliable table/shift context permits limited field reuse while observed facts remain fully written, retaining 97.5 hours plus upkeep for 1.5 net.

role.altitude: Retain consequential player, staff and policy judgement while improving the associated records and drafts.
reach: Coordinate clearer hiring, benefit and concern records with HR, service and security colleagues
role.ambitious_version: A gambling manager with less repetitive administration and more attention for accountable floor and people management.
